news.title: Deepseek open-sources the inference engine that powers its fastest and cheapest AI model
news.summary: Deepseek is open-sourcing DeepInfer, the inference framework behind its fast V4.1-Flash model. The vLLM-based system cuts compute costs and energy use when running AI models.

news.title: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
news.summary: The proposed policy seems to offer protections against AI running amok but actually forbids federal agencies from blocking a model's release without the permission of a judge.

news.title: Google has joined Amazon in attacking Nvidia’s stronghold with AI app developers
news.summary: Google has joined Amazon in releasing a developer tool that makes it easy for PyTorch users to move their apps off Nvidia GPUs.

news.title: Elevenlabs releases two new speech-to-speech models designed for real-time AI conversations
news.summary: Elevenlabs' new Eleven Realtime speech-to-speech models combine speed and accuracy. The v1 Max variant scores 98.8 percent on the Big Bench Audio benchmark with a 0.57-second response time.

news.title: Mistral AI launches Voxtral 3, a full voice agent stack that listens, thinks, and talks in real time
news.summary: Mistral AI launched Voxtral 3, a new family of language models built for real-time voice agents.

news.title: Hugging Face CEO warns that Netflix’s OpenAI hack documentary isn’t accurate
news.summary: Before you share the Netflix documentary "AI Gone Rogue," take note. Clem Delangue, Hugging Face's co-founder who is featured in the film, says it went "full doomer mode" and isn't accurate.

news.title: OpenAI acquires startup Orchestra Bio⁠ to beef up its biotech business

news.title: Meta’s Muse hits 10M US downloads in 40 days, a milestone reached by only 11 other apps
news.summary: New data also shows Muse is retaining users at higher rates than its AI rivals.

news.title: Ex-Nvidia-turned-VC Amulya Vishwanath: ‘Physical AI is in its LEGO era’
news.summary: It’s the moment everyone is waiting for — the ChatGPT moment for robotics, Amulya Vishwanath explained to TechCrunch’s Equity.

news.title: Plants can speak using electricity, so this startup built an AI model to decipher their language
news.summary: Electric Plant has built an AI-powered translator to help humans listen to what plants are saying with the subtle electricity coursing through their stems.

news.title: US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems
news.summary: The U.S. has ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products and third-party services built using its technology, citing national security concerns.

news.title: Eka is worth $1.45B thanks to a physical AI model that has experts raving
news.summary: Eka Robotics may be the first robotic arm that is actually good at picking up a wide range of objects, and it is so smooth and human-like, it is wowing the industry.
